public_verify_result_valid_detail: The signing record and its audit chain were verified as unaltered. This confirms the integrity of the recorded evidence; it does not independently establish who created the signature.
public_verify_result_invalid_detail: We could not verify this signing record with the verification key currently available. This does not by itself establish that the signature is invalid or that the signer did not sign — the record may be incomplete, or this company's verification key may have changed since signing.
public_verify_snapshot_unavailable: Content snapshot unavailable — this agreement was signed before snapshots were introduced.
public_verify_token_valid: ✓ Audit chain is intact and Ed25519 signatures are valid.
public_verify_token_footer: This page verifies the signed document against the tenant's Ed25519 public key. For an audit independent of this server, download the evidence pack and use the offline self-verify page (above).
public_viewer_tz_select_aria: Timezone for dates and times on this page
public_viewer_tz_detected_note: Detected from your browser. Pick another if this isn't your zone.
agent_portal_dashboard_subtitle: Your referrals across every team you partner with.

agent_portal_invite_expired_explainer_no: The link is missing the invite token. Most likely the email got mangled in transit. Ask the inspector to copy the full link.
agent_portal_invite_expired_explainer_de: Invites expire after seven days. Ask the inspector for a fresh one -- the link below pre-fills the message.

agent_portal_settings_subtitle: Your public referral slug and the emails we send you.
agent_portal_settings_slug_desc: When you share a booking link with a client, this slug attributes the referral to you so the inspector knows where the client came from.
agent_portal_settings_slug_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (3-32 chars).
agent_portal_settings_notifications_desc: You work with these companies separately, so each one has its own settings.
agent_portal_settings_notify_apply_all: Apply my next change to all {count} companies
agent_portal_settings_notify_no_companie: No companies yet. Once an inspection company adds you as an agent, their notification settings appear here.
agent_portal_settings_slug_error_generic: Couldn't save your slug. Please try again.
agent_portal_settings_notify_error_gener: Couldn't save your notification preferences. Please try again.

agent_portal_settings_timezone_hint: When set, every referral date uses this zone. Otherwise each date shows in the inspecting company's timezone.
agent_portal_settings_timezone_saved: Saved. Your referral dates now use this timezone.
agent_portal_settings_timezone_error_gen: Couldn't save your timezone. Please try again.
agent_portal_settings_legal_desc: The agreement between you and whoever operates this deployment. Your acceptances are kept, so you can read back which version you agreed to and when.
agent_portal_legal_subtitle: What you accepted on this deployment, and when.
agent_portal_legal_history_desc: Newest first. Each entry names the version that was in force and the moment you accepted it.
agent_portal_legal_body_unavailable: This version's text is no longer archived on this deployment. The current text is deliberately not shown in its place, because it is not what you agreed to.
agent_portal_legal_archived_heading: The text of each version you accepted
agent_portal_legal_empty_title: This deployment has not published any agent terms.
agent_portal_legal_empty_body: There is nothing for anyone to accept yet, so there is nothing to record here. The first version you accept appears on this page.
agent_portal_legal_load_failed: Your acceptance record could not be loaded. Refresh the page to try again — nothing about your account has changed.
agent_portal_legal_scope_heading: What these terms do not cover
agent_portal_legal_scope_body: An agent who reaches a report through a link the inspector shared is not acting under these terms. That access comes from the agreement between the inspection company and its client. A person can hold both — an account here, and links to reports from companies they have no account with — and this page describes only the first.
oauth_authorize_intro: wants to access your OpenInspection data. Choose what it can read and change, then authorize.
oauth_authorize_scope_note: Ticking Write also grants Read. Access is limited to your role and to what {clientName} requested.
public_unsubscribe_invalid_body: It may have been sent to an address the company no longer has on file. Reply to the email and ask them to stop sending it, and they can do that from their side.
public_unsubscribe_intro_1: This turns off the emails titled
public_unsubscribe_still_sent: Messages about the inspection itself — your report, agreements and receipts — are sent either way. This does not change them.
public_unsubscribe_resubscribe: Changed your mind? Turn it back on
public_unsubscribe_error: That did not save. Try again in a moment.
